#!/bin/sh
set -eu
tmp=$(mktemp /etc/inventory/.app.conf.XXXXXX)

cat > "$tmp"
chown root:root "$tmp"
chmod 0644 "$tmp"
mv -f "$tmp" /etc/inventory/app.conf
restorecon /etc/inventory/app.conf >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM

chmod 0600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys

printf '%s\n' '-- receiver --'
ls -l /usr/local/sbin/inventory-sync-receive /root/.ssh/authorized_keys /etc/inventory
sshd -t
